attack_description: NIST CORR-DATA is a compilation of 220 distinct original literature sources (source_text field: corrosion handbooks, alloy-vendor bulletins, journal papers across decades). Most sources are family-specialized (e.g. Climax Molybdenum reports mostly molybdenum/nickel alloys; Haynes reports mostly cobalt/ nickel superalloys), so family-safe or per-family LOFO splits do not control for a model that has merely learned a source's own testing methodology / reporting convention rather than a transferable structure-composition-environment relationship. This re-runs the identical feature engineering, HistGBM model, and seed with true Leave-One-Source-Out (n_splits=n_sources in the classified subset, one source held out per fold) on the SAME classified cohort (n=7282, 17 families) used by the promoted KPI and corr-rate-family-lofo-v1, and reports the SOURCE-weighted (unweighted per source) mean R2 alongside the sample-weighted OOF R2.
attacks_claim: evidence/phase0/kpis/corr-rate-family-safe-qspr-kpi.v1.dsse.json: GroupKFold(group=metallurgical_family, 5-fold) HistGBM R2=0.132087 on the NIST CORR-DATA classified subset (n=7282, 17 families), 'the module's strongest rights-clean empirical claim'; and, by extension, corr-rate-family-lofo-v1's CLAIM_SURVIVED verdict (family-weighted mean R2=0.015964).

comparison_to_promoted_kpi.note: kpi number is sample-weighted, 5-fold, grouped by metallurgical family; loso_sample_weighted_oof_r2 is the directly comparable per-row OOF statistic under true source-grouped LOSO; loso_source_weighted_mean_r2 treats every literature source as one equally-weighted unit -- the honest reading of whether the model transfers across independent data-collection provenance, not just across metallurgical families that happen to share a source.

dataset.name: NIST CORR-DATA (Dow Chemical Co.) derived reference

refutation_criterion: REFUTED if (a) source-count-weighted (unweighted-per-source) mean LOSO R2 over sources with n_test>=20 in the classified subset <= 0.0, OR (b) a majority (>50%) of those eligible sources individually score LOSO R2 <= 0.0. SURVIVED if source-weighted mean R2 > 0.0 AND a majority of eligible sources individually score R2 > 0.0, even if reduced relative to the family-safe/LOFO numbers (some reduction from a different, potentially harder, axis is expected and is not itself a refutation).
